title: Tate brothers denied bail as they fight extradition to UK
text:
A Florida judge has decided that Andrew and Tristan Tate must remain in jail pending their extradition to the United Kingdom on dozens of sex crime charges.

U.S. Magistrate Judge Lauren Louis decided on Wednesday to deny bail to the defendants, who will remain imprisoned at Miami’s Federal Detention Center. The decision came nearly two weeks after Louis held a court hearing on the matter.
